description_short: A heartfelt birthday celebration featuring creative presentations of core Buddhist teachings through poetry, art, and humor from the Satipañña community.
description_long:
This special episode captures the warm celebration of Bhante Bodhidhamma's 70th birthday, featuring creative presentations from the Satipañña community and international dharma friends. The celebration includes musical offerings, artistic interpretations of fundamental Buddhist teachings, and thoughtful reflections on core doctrines.

Highlights include illustrated presentations of the Four Noble Truths, a humorous take on the Twelve Links of Dependent Origination (paṭicca samuppāda) told through "The Wheel of Dandelion Origination," and creative explorations of the Six Sense Spheres from the Sabbāsava Sutta. The episode also features poetry by William Blake and Kabir, alongside original compositions that weave together Buddhist wisdom with accessible metaphors.

These presentations demonstrate how ancient Buddhist teachings can be understood through contemporary art, humor, and creativity while maintaining their profound wisdom. From the cessation of suffering in nibbāna to the practical understanding of how desire and passion create fetters in daily experience, this celebration shows the dharma's relevance across cultures and generations.
